name: clawd-hud-zq
description: clawd-hud-zq: a HUD side pane for Claude Code with session facts, subagents and animated mascots.

plugins.name: mod-hud
plugins.description: A side pane, toggled by /mod-hud: a HUD of the session (session, alerts, context, limits, cost, git, the tool running now, todos) above every subagent in it (type, model, status, elapsed time, tool calls, current tool, result), with an opt-in status line.
